data.gender_notes: Areta is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'arete,' meaning 'virtue' or 'excellence.' In Greek mythology, Arete was the goddess of virtue and wisdom. In Christian tradition, the name Areta symbolizes moral goodness and noble character. The name Areta carries the meaning “Noble, virtuous” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Areta usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, virtuous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies virtuous living and spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Areta belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Noble, virtuous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Areta total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
